svg.title: betaSieve research software workflow
svg.desc: Editable overview of EPICv2 beta-value loading, correct IlmnID interpretation, probe grouping, optional threshold selection, statistical testing, and outputs.

text.tspan: betaSieve identifies HumanMethylationEPIC v2.0 BeadChip (EPICv2) probes
that exhibit high variability between measurements of different probe designs.

g.text: Infinium design Type I / Type II

svg.text: Same CpG site, same probe sequence;
Same CpG site, different probe sequences;
one or more suffix positions (1–3) differ.
betaSieve groups probes by (CpG site, Design) and calculates the maximum difference.
2. Collect probe designs under that CpG site
3. Form design groups from the probe designs per CpG site:
For each (CpG site, design group, sample):
Report figure: Δβ distribution by design group
Report figure: per-CpG site × per-sample difference
Threshold t converts continuous differences into binary exceedances
from tmin, tmax, step and target p₀
Binary exceedances define the null model and site-level p-values
Exact replicates are the gold standard for technical disagreement: p₀ = pooled fraction with Y = 1.
Exact-replicate p̂ null with model diagnostics
Report figure: p̂ by design group with p₀ baseline
Flagged IlmnIDs exhibiting high variability between probe designs.
CpG site-by-design group results: per-sample Δβ, p̂, p₀,
test statistics, adjusted p-values and flags.
Single-column IlmnID list containing every probe at each
CpG site flagged as discordant, regardless of probe design.
Analysis parameters, dataset summary, report-native plots,
threshold summary, null-model evaluation and file dictionary.
Automatic-sweep runs only: one row per design group
and candidate t, with p₀ and percentages of flagged CpG Names.
Probe-code interpretation: Peters et al., BMC Genomics 2024;25:251 and accompanying Supplementary File 4. Visual forms mirror betaSieve report.html.
